meaning:
ἄ-σπιλος, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σπῖλος) [in Sm.: Job.15:15 (LXX, καθαρός)* ;]
spotless, unstained: 1Pe.1:19; metaphorically, 1Ti.6:14, Jas.1:27, 2Pe.3:14 (for exx., see MM, see word).†
SYN.: ἀμίαντος, ἄμωμος (AS)

elsewhere.note: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the…
but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,
Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.
